title: Public Chapa verify route changes order state from a guessable reference
expected: Payment status is readable only by the order's parties; state changes come only from the verified provider callback.
actual: GET /api/orders/chapa/status/:tx_ref and GET /chapa/verify/:tx_ref need no authentication. tx_ref is ndb-<first 8 chars of user id>-<ms timestamp>. Verify asks Chapa and, if Chapa does not report success, moves pending orders to payment_failed.
impact: Someone who can derive a reference can read a pending order's status or mark a buyer's in-progress Chapa payment as failed. Rated Low because new Chapa order checkout returns 410 (platform no longer collects funds), so only legacy in-flight orders are exposed; CVSS base 6.3 does not account for that.
fix: Use crypto.randomUUID() for tx_ref; require auth (buyer or seller) for status; make verify idempotent and non-destructive (only transition to paid on verified success; leave failures to the webhook/expiry job). Retire the routes once legacy orders settle.
